name: Electron Capital Partners
decision_note: Brno multi-family office of the Tescan founders (private equity, real estate, listed securities) that also backs startups (HTG Medical July 2026, co-led Carebot October 2026) - a family office, not a VC fund.

evidence.quote: Skupina Electron je rodinná investiční kancelář a správce rodinného majetku zakladatelů společnosti Tescan Group, a.s., globálního výrobce elektronových mikroskopů v Brně.
Electron Capital Partners má za cíl uchování a růst rodinného majetku skrze diversifikované portfolio investic do private equity, nemovitostí a obchodovatelných cenných papírů.
Právě díky tomu se z fondu stal plnohodnotný family office, ve kterém již desetičlenný tým o tento kapitál pečuje.
Do financování se zapojily fondy Garage Angels, Electron Capital Partners a JIC Ventures i stávající investoři Jinej fond a Dendis Capital.
The new funding round was led by Garage Angels and Electron Capital Partners, along with new investor JIC Ventures, alongside existing backers Gain Ventures and Eva Janečková.
The Czech medtech startup Carebot, led by CEO Matěj Misař, has secured the largest investment in its history — more than €1.5 million (over 36 million crowns).

analyst_notes: Quick exclusion dossier (S1, family office). The own site calls the Electron group a family investment office managing the wealth of the Tescan Group founders (e1), investing in private equity, real estate and listed securities (e2); CzechCrunch (2025-10-21) describes a ten-person multi-family office of four Tescan founder families managing billions of CZK (no exact figure, so capital not recorded) that also wants startups. Startup activity is current: second pre-seed tranche of HTG Medical (EUR 450k, Lupa 2026-07-14, e4) and co-lead of Carebot's round of more than EUR 1.5m (Around Prague 2026-10-02, e5/e6; amount recorded as the lower bound). No separately branded VC fund or team found (brand rule); ARES shows many SPVs at the Brno address (Electron C.P. Technology I-VIII, Estate I-VI, Treasury, Winery). Electron C.P. Investment, a.s. is the website operator and a statutory member of Electron Capital Partners, a.s.
